item.title: Mob sets BRT Bus ablaze after motorcyclist’s death in Lagos
item.dc:creator: Punch Newspapers
item.description:
An angry mob has reportedly set a Bus Rapid Transit vehicle ablaze after it crushed a commercial motorcyclist to death at Ogolonto bus stop in Ikorodu, Lagos State. The incident reportedly sparked outrage among residents, with police officers and officials of the Lagos Neighbourhood Safety Corps intervening to rescue the bus driver from the mob.
Read More: https://punchng.com/mob-sets-brt-bus-ablaze-after-motorcyclists-death-in-lagos/
